description: Deterministic policy for the research-trend and theme-evolution skill. Every threshold below is applied mechanically by scripts/sk_entry.py; no network or model call is made.

lifecycle.rule: emerging: first seen within the last two years with latest-half activity; growing: late >= 2x early; declining: early >= 2x late; dormant: no record in the last three years; otherwise stable

status.success: a topic and at least two dated records spanning two or more years
status.partial: records exist but fewer than two are dated, or all dated records fall in one year
status.insufficient_input: no topic or no record was supplied
status.failed: the case file could not be read or the analysis raised an unhandled error

evidence.locator_rule: locators are JSON pointers into the supplied case.json (for example /records/2), never page numbers of a generated report
evidence.quote_rule: quotes are exact substrings of the cited field; truncation keeps a prefix and sets truncated=true
evidence.claim_rule: each trend, evolution, representative and gap claim carries at least one locator and quote, or is marked not_determinable

no_fabrication: never invent records, years, venues, citation counts or open questions
never report a batch-absent term as a field-level research gap
never claim a merge or split from term counts alone; only co-occurrence candidates are reported
source_declaration: All sources are the records supplied in the case file; the skill performs no external retrieval and does not verify that the records exist.
